app.name: Custock
app.tagline: A clean blend of Customer and Stock

error.conflict: Someone changed this a moment ago. Reload to see the latest.
error.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
error.scope: This is outside the shops you manage.
error.ceiling: You can only give permissions you have yourself.
error.rank: You can only manage roles below yours.
error.self: You cannot change your own access.
error.last_owner: A business needs at least one owner. Transfer ownership first.
error.barcode_taken: This code is already on another product.
error.negative_stock_blocked: This would make stock negative, and this business does not allow that.
error.invite_expired: This invite has expired. Ask for a new one.
error.invite_email_mismatch: This invite was sent to a different email.
error.join_link_disabled: This code is no longer active.
error.account_exists: This email already has an account. Sign in to accept.
error.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
error.offline: No signal. Your scans are saved and will sync when you are back online.
error.network: The connection dropped. Check the signal and try again.
error.feature_off: This is not available right now.
error.org_suspended: This business is paused right now.
error.limit_reached: This is not available right now.
error.platform_paused: This is paused for now. Try again later.
error.last_superadmin: The last super admin cannot be removed.
error.storage_full: Photos cannot be added right now. Everything already uploaded stays.
error.reset_expired: This link no longer works. Ask for a new one.
error.upload_failed: The photo could not be added. Try again.
error.orders_off: This shop does not take orders right now.
error.prices_changed: A price changed in the meantime. Check the order again.
error.quote_expired: This price no longer holds. You can order again.

perm.joinlinks.manage: Manage QR codes and join links
perm.orders.quote: Send prices, confirm and decline orders
perm.orders.fulfil: Prepare orders and hand them over

push.dailyCap.title: Notifications per customer a day
push.dailyCap.foot: The most push notifications one customer gets from this business in a day.

push.quietHours.title: Quiet hours
push.quietHours.foot: Notifications wait until the morning. The window can be longer, never shorter than the platform one.

posts.needApproval.title: Posts need approval
posts.needApproval.foot: Posts wait for someone who can approve them.

posts.dailyLimit.title: Posts a day
posts.dailyLimit.foot: How many posts one person sends in 24 hours.

stock.allowNegative.title: Sell below zero
stock.allowNegative.foot: Sales go through even when the count says none are left.

stock.fewLeft.title: "Only a few left" from
stock.fewLeft.foot: Customers see it at or below this number.

stock.adjustLimit.title: Largest correction
stock.adjustLimit.foot: The biggest change one correction makes. Bigger differences go through a count.

catalog.offerPrices.title: Show prices in offers
catalog.offerPrices.foot: With prices hidden on the shop page, offers still show their own price and the lowest price of the last 30 days.

alerts.lowStock.title: Running low
alerts.lowStock.foot: When a product drops to its low stock level.

alerts.transfers.title: Deliveries on the way
alerts.transfers.foot: When a transfer is sent to your shop.

alerts.approvals.title: Posts to approve
alerts.approvals.foot: When a post waits for approval.

alerts.counts.title: Counts to review
alerts.counts.foot: When a stock count is sent for review.

auth.accessMinutes.title: Sign in check
auth.accessMinutes.foot: How often the app checks the sign in in the background.

auth.sessionDays.title: Stay signed in
auth.sessionDays.foot: Days without use before someone signs in again.

orders.mode.title: Orders from customers
orders.mode.foot: Ask for a price: the shop answers every order with a price. At shown prices: orders go in at the prices customers see, the shop confirms.

orders.maxLines.title: Products in one order
orders.maxLines.foot: The most different products one order can hold.

orders.maxQty.title: Most of one product
orders.maxQty.foot: In pieces, or kg and litres for products sold by weight.

orders.openPerCustomer.title: Open orders per customer
orders.openPerCustomer.foot: Orders one customer can have going at once.

orders.quoteDays.title: A price holds for
orders.quoteDays.foot: After that the customer has to ask again.

orders.takeStock.title: Take stock when picked up
orders.takeStock.foot: Picked up orders count as sales and the stock goes down.

alerts.orders.title: Orders
alerts.orders.foot: When a customer orders, answers a price or cancels.

policyGroup.lifetimes: How long links and codes work

field.sameAsEmail: Use something other than your email.
field.checkDigit: The last digit does not match. Check the code.
field.notHttps: The link must start with https://
field.past: Pick a time that is not in the past.
field.beforeStart: The end must be after the start.

money.tooManyDecimals: Prices have two decimals at most.

email.invalid: Check the email, for example name@example.com.

slug.invalid: Small Latin letters, numbers and dashes only.

barcode.invalid: Letters, numbers and simple symbols only.
